title: C: Bubble Sort
description: Implement the bubble sort algorithm to sort an array of integers in ascending order.

steps.title: Bubble Sort Implementation
steps.description: Write a function `void bubble_sort(int arr[], int n)` that sorts an array using bubble sort. Test with `{64, 34, 25, 12, 22, 11, 90}` and print the sorted array.
hints: Nested loops: outer for passes, inner for comparisons.
Optimize: after a pass with no swaps, array is sorted.

verification.failureMessage: Sort the array and print it in ascending order
